name: AGF Korea
blurb: South Korea's largest anime and game expo at KINTEX, with exhibitor booths, stage talk shows and Virtual YouTuber content.
notes: Official site is www.agfkorea.com (the bare agfkorea.com given in the seed redirects there). Organizer line on the event page lists four co-organizing companies (ANIPLUS INC., Daewon Media, Sony Music Solutions, D&C Media); Aniplus is listed first and is the best-known. The site has no guest/lineup page structure (nav is 행사정보/전시참가/이벤트/티켓안내/커뮤니티) — stage events (seiyuu talk shows, artist mini-concerts, VTuber reveals) are mentioned generically but no named 2026 performers are published yet, so guests is none-yet rather than guessed.
